# Roofline Lab: Predict Then Measure

Every high-performance kernel is bounded by one of two physical constraints:
1. **Compute Bound:** The execution units are saturated doing arithmetic; the memory bus sits idle.
2. **Memory Bound:** The execution units starve waiting for data to arrive from DRAM; FLOP utilization is low.

### The Roofline Chart

The Roofline Model visualizes maximum achievable performance as a function of **Operational Intensity** (also called Arithmetic Intensity):

$$\text{Operational Intensity} = \frac{\text{Total FLOPs}}{\text{Total Bytes Transferred from DRAM}}$$

$$\text{Attainable Performance (GFLOP/s)} = \min\left(\text{Peak Hardware Compute}, \text{Peak Memory Bandwidth} \times \text{Operational Intensity}\right)$$

```text
Performance (TFLOP/s)
  ^
  |        Peak Compute Roof (TFLOP/s)
  |      +----------------------------------------- (Compute Bound)
  |     /
  |    /
  |   /  Memory Bandwidth Slope
  |  /   (TFLOP/s = Bandwidth * Intensity)
  | /
  |/     (Memory Bound)
  +---------------------------------------------------->
  0                   Inflection Point       Operational Intensity (FLOPs/Byte)
```

### Hands-on Lab: Predicting PyTorch Operations

Consider a vector addition $y = x + z$ vs Matrix Multiplication $C = A \cdot B$ on an NVIDIA A100 (Peak FP32 Compute = 19.5 TFLOP/s, Memory Bandwidth = 1,935 GB/s):
- **Vector Add ($N = 10^7$ floats):**
  - Operations: $10^7$ additions (0.01 GFLOPs).
  - Memory: Read $2 \times 40$ MB, Write $1 \times 40$ MB = 120 MB.
  - Operational Intensity: $\frac{10^7 \text{ FLOPs}}{120 \times 10^6 \text{ Bytes}} \approx 0.083 \text{ FLOPs/Byte}$.
  - Bound: Strictly **Memory-Bound**. Speed limit = $1935 \text{ GB/s} \times 0.083 \approx 160 \text{ GFLOP/s}$ (less than 1% of peak compute!).
- **Dense GEMM ($M=K=N=4096$):**
  - Operations: $2 \times 4096^3 \approx 1.37 \times 10^{11}$ FLOPs.
  - Memory: $3 \times 4096^2 \times 4 \text{ B} \approx 201 \text{ MB}$.
  - Operational Intensity: $\frac{1.37 \times 10^{11}}{2.01 \times 10^8} \approx 680 \text{ FLOPs/Byte}$.
  - Bound: Strictly **Compute-Bound**.
